description: Chat system redesign - multi-turn conversation, streaming SSE, Chinese retrieval, question routing, separate chat engine

userStories.title: Create chat-specific system prompt
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dedicated chat prompt template so the model responds as a conversational tutor, not a lecturer.
acceptanceCriteria: New file app/services/chat_prompts.py exists
Contains build_chat_system_prompt(slide_context, explanation_summary) returning a system message string
Prompt instructs conversational tutor behavior: concise answers, reference prior context, no full re-explanation
Prompt includes placeholders for slide extracted text and cached explanation summary
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add multi-turn message support to ModelGateway
userStories.description: As a developer, I need ModelGateway to accept a full messages array instead of only single user messages.
acceptanceCriteria: New method ModelGateway.chat_completion(messages: list[dict]) accepts system/user/assistant message array
Supports OpenAI-compatible format: messages array passed directly
Supports Anthropic format: system message extracted to top-level 'system' field
Logs token usage via existing _log_usage method
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create ChatEngine service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dedicated chat engine that assembles conversation context and invokes the model.
acceptanceCriteria: New file app/services/chat_engine.py exists
Function generate_chat_response(conversation_history, slide_context, slide_image_path, question, cached_explanation) returns answer string
Assembles messages: system prompt + last 8 conversation messages + current question
Injects cached SlideExplanation.markdown (first 500 chars) as context in system prompt
Falls back to template response if no model configured
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Rewrite chat endpoint to use ChatEngine
userStories.description: As a user, I want my follow-up questions to reference previous conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/chat queries last 10 Messages for the session from database before calling model
Passes conversation history to ChatEngine.generate_chat_response()
No longer calls generate_slide_explanation() for chat
User message and assistant response still saved to Message table
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix global mode to use AI
userStories.description: As a user, I want global mode chat to use AI instead of returning a hardcoded template.
acceptanceCriteria: When no matching slide found, ChatEngine generates AI response using document-level context
System prompt includes document title and summary of slide explanations
Hardcoded template string removed from chat.py
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix Chinese text retrieval
userStories.description: As a user, I want to ask questions in Chinese and have the system find relevant slides.
acceptanceCriteria: retrieval.py _tokenize() extracts Chinese character bigrams alongside ASCII tokens
Query '什么是互斥锁' matches a slide containing '互斥锁' in extracted text
English queries still work (existing behavior preserved)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add SSE streaming to ModelGateway
userStories.description: As a developer, I need ModelGateway to support streaming responses.
acceptanceCriteria: New method ModelGateway.stream_chat_completion(messages) yields string chunks
Uses httpx streaming with stream=true in payload for OpenAI-compatible API
Parses SSE data lines and yields choices[0].delta.content
Handles [DONE] terminator
Logs total usage after stream completes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add SSE streaming chat endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the tutor's response appear word by word.
acceptanceCriteria: New endpoint POST /api/v1/chat/stream returns text/event-stream SSE response
Each SSE event: {delta: 'text chunk'}
Final event: {done: true, answer: 'full text'}
Full response saved to Message table after stream completes
sse-starlette package added to requirements
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Frontend SSE chat integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want the chat panel to show streaming text as it arrives.
acceptanceCriteria: api.ts has streamChatResponse(params) using fetch ReadableStream
Chat panel component calls streaming endpoint and appends chunks to displayed message
Shows typing indicator while streaming
Falls back to non-streaming endpoint if SSE connection fails
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Inject cached explanations as chat context
userStories.description: As a developer, I want chat to reference pre-generated slide explanations.
acceptanceCriteria: ChatEngine queries SlideExplanation for current slide before calling model
If explanation exists, first 800 chars included in system prompt as context
Model instructed to reference this context rather than re-explaining
Chat works without explanation (just without extra context)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Conversation context window management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to manage conversation length to stay within token budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: ChatEngine limits conversation history to last 8 messages (4 turns)
Total estimated input tokens logged for monitoring
If history exceeds 6000 tokens, oldest messages trimmed first
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Question type classification and routing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to classify questions to adjust response style.
acceptanceCriteria: New function classify_question(text) returns: clarification, deep_dive, comparison, verification, or meta
Uses keyword matching only (no LLM call): '什么意思/为什么' → clarification, '展开讲/详细' → deep_dive, '和第X页/区别' → comparison
Classification appended to system prompt as style instruction
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Cross-slide comparison support
userStories.description: As a user, I want to ask about relationships between different slides.
acceptanceCriteria: When question type is 'comparison' and mentions page numbers, ChatEngine fetches context from multiple slides
Both slides' extracted text and explanation summaries injected as context
System prompt instructs comparative analysis
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: ROI chat with conversation history
userStories.description: As a user, I want ROI region chat to support follow-up questions.
acceptanceCriteria: ROI endpoint /api/v1/chat/roi queries conversation history like main chat endpoint
Previous messages about same ROI region included as context
Uses ChatEngine instead of generate_roi_explanation() for response
Typecheck passes
